The minimal PoC with just `6` (a single digit at the end of the buffer) triggers the heap-buffer-overflow. The bug is in `md_is_container_mark` at line 5659: after the digit loop, `off` reaches `ctx->size`, and `CH(off)` reads out of bounds.

Now let me understand the full call chain to write the trace. Let me look at `md_analyze_line` around line 5942 and `md_process_doc` around 6259.
